## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` pass
- [ ] `npm test` passes (and I added/updated unit tests for the change)
- [ ] If I added or changed public API, I updated the API reference table in `README.md`
- [ ] If this change affects published behavior, I ran `npm run changeset` and committed the generated file
- [ ] If I touched `mutations.ts`, I cross-checked the business rule against [LighterPack's own client](https://github.com/galenmaly/lighterpack/blob/main/client/dataTypes.js)
